name: Lumentum Holdings
thesis: Lumentum is a datacenter-optics inflection: the Optical Communications segment (external / ultra-high-power lasers for co-packaged optics) is driving revenue acceleration ($337M FQ1'25 -> $808M FQ3'26) and margin expansion (gross 23% -> 44%, operating -24% -> +22%) as AI-cluster bandwidth scales 800G -> 1.6T -> 3.2T. The bull case (OFC 2026 analysis) rests on a narrow-linewidth / high-power-laser engineering lead that plugs into ring-modulator CPO, anchored by Nvidia's $2B investment and a rapid fab expansion. Break rules track the inflection REVERSING (revenue deceleration, margin-moat erosion, operating-leverage loss) - the moat is a lead, not a monopoly, and is actively contested by VCSEL NPO/CPO (Coherent), MOPA lasers (Furukawa), and SiPho integration (Tower/GloFo). Separately, the valuation is stretched: at ~$763 the market implies a ~66% 5-yr revenue CAGR / ~70x EV/EBITDA exit vs a debt-corrected DCF base fair value of ~$184 - the operational thesis and the valuation point in opposite directions. MoS bar 30%.
key_driver: Datacenter CPO / ultra-high-power laser ramp (Optical Communications segment); linewidth + high-power engineering lead vs VCSEL, MOPA, and SiPho integration

tier_1_kpis.name: Revenue YoY Growth (USD)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Revenue YoY <15% for 2 consecutive Qs - the CPO inflection stalling (vs +90% now)

tier_1_kpis.name: Gross Margin (GAAP)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Gross margin <35% for 2 consecutive Qs - loss of the margin step-up / pricing pressure from VCSEL, MOPA, or integrated rivals

tier_1_kpis.name: Operating Margin (GAAP)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Operating margin <5% for 2 consecutive Qs - operating leverage breaking down

tier_1_kpis.name: Valuation vs DCF fair value
tier_1_kpis.current: ~$763 price vs ~$184 debt-corrected DCF base (~+315% over fair; bull $249 / bear $133)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Monitor only - market implies ~66% 5-yr revenue CAGR / ~70x EV/EBITDA exit; buy discipline governed by MoS bar 30%

tier_2_kpis.current: Monitor - qualification success unlocks hyperscaler deployment
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Loss or slippage of a named CPO/UHP-laser design win at a lead hyperscaler

tier_2_kpis.name: Nvidia customer concentration
tier_2_kpis.current: Monitor - Nvidia $2B strategic investment; concentration is both anchor and single-point risk
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Nvidia demand pause or second-sourcing away from Lumentum

tier_2_kpis.name: Optical Communications segment revenue trajectory
tier_2_kpis.current: Monitor - the CPO/datacenter engine; QoQ decline is the leading tell before consolidated revenue rolls over
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Optical Comms segment revenue declines QoQ for 2 consecutive Qs

tier_2_kpis.name: Convertible-note dilution
tier_2_kpis.current: Monitor - ~$3.25B converts now captured in total debt; deeply ITM at ~$763, so if-converted dilution is not yet in the 96.2M diluted share count
tier_2_kpis.break_condition: Modeling watch, not a thesis break - see off-BS if-converted scope

break_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY growth below 15% for 2 consecutive quarters - the datacenter/CPO inflection has stalled (thesis bet is sustained 25%+ growth off the current +90% ramp).

Gross margin back below 35% for 2 consecutive quarters - the recent step-up (23% -> 44%) is reversing, signalling pricing pressure as VCSEL NPO/CPO, MOPA lasers, or vertically-integrated rivals erode the linewidth premium.
Operating margin below 5% for 2 consecutive quarters - the operating-leverage flip (-24% -> +22%) has reversed and the scale story is not holding.
Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters - outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters - operating loss.
Gross margin below 20% for 2 consecutive quarters - severe pricing/cost issue.
GAAP net income negative for 2 consecutive quarters - bottom-line loss.
Capex/Revenue above 25% for 2 consecutive Qs - capex bloat without proportional revenue.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs - cash conversion broken.
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.
